source.expected_data_rows: Approximately 74,065 lines including header; exact count to be audited
source.separate_from: DiLeo et al. 2024 Dryad 10.5061/dryad.905qfttrg; not the same records, source version, column definitions or reference.

prior_art: Schulz et al. 2020 already showed plant abundance and both-host presence predict butterfly occupancy/abundance; not new.
Opedal et al. 2020 Ecology 10.1002/ecy.3186 already modeled colonization/extinction responses of M. cinxia and a parasitoid to the two host plants, climate/connectivity.
Hanski & Singer 2001 already examined host association in colonization. Thus a basic high-plantago/low extinction association is prior art.
question: When local abundance of Veronica decreases, does Plantago availability at the end of the decline predict the next-year persistence of already-occupied Melitaea populations beyond static amounts and previous population size?

comparison.time: three strictly consecutive annual autumn patch surveys t−1,t,t+1; host decline measured t−1→t; next-year occupancy measured at t+1
comparison.risk_set: observed population(t)>0 and all three years documented; no imputing missing years as zero
comparison.high_backup: plantago(t)>=2 if source states 0–3 ordinal cover; only define after original file codebook confirms
comparison.analyzed_unit: patch-year triple clustered by patch and calendar year
comparison.negative_control: If data are feasible, holdout comparison within nondeclining Veronica patches; do not treat this as a random treatment.

source_gate.required: Archive MD5 matches and original text table is exactly present; source README confirms measurement codes, missingness and date interpretation.
stop_if: Plantago or Veronica are not valid 0-3 ordinal scores
population zero is not consistent with non-occupancy or survey missingness ambiguous
patch-year not unique or cannot be deduplicated by original documented procedure
too few intact consecutive autumn survey triples
less than 40 decline exposures in each backup stratum
less than 30 unique patches in either stratum
less than 3 independent calendar years per stratum
less than 20 next-year zero outcomes across decline strata
population connectivity and time-dependent confounding cannot be represented adequately for model-based generalization
report_even_if_fail: actual source codebook and column names
risk-set sizes and decline events in four cells

statistics_if_source_gate_passes.baseline: current + lagged host plant level (both hosts), log1p(current nest count), year effects, site area, site coordinates/connectivity if available, grazing/host desiccation if unambiguously measured
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.added_term: prespecified Veronica-decline indicator × binary Plantago backup level, with main decline and backup terms; fit on all occupied risk-set triples, NOT decline-only rows
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.method: regularized binary prediction model with same covariates, frozen penalty by blind study metadata (no outcome-tuned hyperparameters)
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.holdout: leave-one-calendar-year-out, with optional geographically blocked check if reliable positions and enough sites
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.primary_statistic: held-out cross-entropy improvement, base minus augmented; no claim from in-sample interaction p-value alone
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.minimum_relevance: 95% patch-/year-cluster uncertainty excluding zero with positive improvement and no single year driving the sign, subject to effective temporal replication; effects describe predictive moderation, not causal backup
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.secondary: absolute next-year occupancy probabilities for held-out high/low Plantago and decline/stable strata with uncertainty
statistics_if_source_gate_passes.strong_claim_stop: Do not call the direction an evolutionary memory or invasion consequence: no randomized host loss, no introduced-host comparison, no maternal lineages and possible dispersal between patches.

decision: Data exploration remains unpublished mechanism pilot until independent effect, novelty and robustness are checked.
